tasks.site:publish: deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.119.0 pages deploy site/dist --project-name rustyauth-dev --branch main --commit-dirty=true
tasks.fmt: cargo fmt && deno fmt deno.json site/src site/tests site/astro.config.mjs site/deno.json site/package.json
tasks.fmt:check: cargo fmt --check && deno fmt --check deno.json site/src site/tests site/astro.config.mjs site/deno.json site/package.json && cd infra/cloudflare && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
tasks.lint: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && deno lint site/src site/tests site/astro.config.mjs && cd infra/cloudflare && go vet ./...
tasks.check: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task site:check
tasks.test: deno task site:test && cargo test --locked && cd infra/cloudflare && go test ./...
